svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two plates 120 x 90 x 45 mm, faces flat to 0.02 mm (milled).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower plate: cavity 64 x 50 x 6 mm deep, centred in the top face, 1 degree

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: draft, 1 mm corner radius. Four M10 thread inserts at 48 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 33 mm each side of centre (drill and tap for the insert, 25 deep).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper plate: four 11 mm holes on the same positions; sprue through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre, 5 mm at the top to 7 mm at the parting line, polished.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spherical seat for the nozzle in the top face: 12.5 mm radius, 2 mm deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dowels: two 6 mm holes at 48 mm each side on the centre line, 12 deep in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each plate; press fit in the lower plate, slip fit in the upper.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vents: two 0.03 mm deep, 5 mm wide, from the cavity's far end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M10 x 70 cap screws at 20 kN preload (about 40 N m).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: blue on the parting faces shows full contact round the cavity.
